usage.source_scope: Six source-audited Hong Kong named entities, 12 public reference images, 6 calibration views, and 11 evaluation views drawn from a frozen 50-image Commons library.
usage.project_application: Supply a non-OCR identity branch for the find-correct-building stage before entrance binding and temporal guidance.
usage.modifications: CLIP global reference similarity, DINOv2 pooled appearance, and mutual-patch affine consistency; OCR calls fixed at zero for the first falsifier.
usage.expected_effect: Reject wrong named entities when text is absent or unreadable, while a richer multi-facet reference bank should raise correct-entity retrieval.

evaluation.claim_boundary: The first frozen run kept top-1 at 6/11, reduced wrong-goal false confirmations 3 to 0 versus global references, and improved balanced accuracy 65.45% to 68.18%, but failed the predeclared top-1 gate. Do not tune this cohort; expand the reference information source before another fresh run.

history.change: Category membership is not visibility truth; teacher or metadata source admission cannot be promoted to evaluator truth.
